title: SQL injection: untrusted input reaches 'sql_execute_var' sink
remediation: Use parameterised queries / bound parameters everywhere (cursor.execute(sql, params); pandas.read_sql(sql, con, params=...)). Never build SQL with .format()/%/f-strings/concatenation on request data.

title: OS command injection: untrusted input reaches a shell command
remediation: Avoid the shell: pass an argument list with shell=False, or escape every argument with shlex.quote(); validate against an allow-list of permitted commands.

title: Path traversal: user-controlled path reaches a file sink
remediation: Resolve against a fixed base directory and verify the canonical path stays inside it; reject '..' segments; prefer an allow-list of filenames.

title: Server-side template injection (SSTI): untrusted input is compiled as a template
remediation: Never build a template from request input; pass user data as template CONTEXT (variables), never as the template string itself.
